## About
Precision Transmission is a transmission and auto repair shop on Crescent Boulevard in Pennsauken. Steve Gorman and his team handle transmission repairs and maintenance, plus clutch, brake and general auto repairs.
We'd rather tell you what your vehicle actually needs than sell you a job it doesn't. One reviewer wrote that other transmission centers wanted to rebuild, but we took our time with the diagnosis and saved their company a lot of money.
We're rated 4.7 from 108 Google reviews. Call, stop by, or send us a note through the form and we'll get back to you.

## Services
- Transmission Repairs: Comprehensive transmission repairs, starting with an honest look at what's actually wrong.
- Transmission Maintenance: Routine transmission work to keep things shifting the way they should.
- Full transmission replacement: When a transmission gives out completely, we can put in a full replacement. One reviewer had this done on a Chevy Malibu.
- Manual rebuilds: One reviewer recommends Steve for manual rebuilds in the tri-state area.
- Clutch Repairs: Slipping or worn clutch? Our mechanics can take care of it.
- Brake Repairs: Brake work done right at a fair price.
- Auto Repairs: General repairs and maintenance for cars and trucks, not just transmissions.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 9400 Crescent Boulevard (Route 130) in Pennsauken, NJ.

Q: Do you only work on transmissions?
A: No. Along with transmission work, we handle maintenance, clutch, brake and general auto repairs.
